title: Not Just Oversmoothing: Detecting the Echo Chamber Effect in Graph Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2609.06521v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Oversmoothing is a well-known failure mode of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). However, most existing diagnostics rely on global aggregation measures that fail to capture the heterogeneous dynamics of message passing. Real-world graphs exhibit pronounced community structure, and message passing operates on two timescales, with representations collapsing rapidly within communities and slowly across them. This creates a critical gap in which intra-community representations can become indistinguishable while inter community separation persists, a failure mode that we refer to as the Echo Chamber Effect. To quantify this effect, we introduce the Echo Chamber Index (ECI), which stratifies pairwise distances by community membership and reveals when global energy diminishes while inter-community separation persists. ECI further shows that feature retention mechanisms can preserve the echo chamber under the conditions of our theoretical analysis. T

translated_title: 不仅仅是过度平滑：检测图神经网络中的回音室效应
translated_abstract: 过度平滑是图神经网络（GNNs）一个众所周知的失效模式。然而，现有的大多数诊断方法依赖于全局聚合度量，无法捕捉消息传递的异质性动态。现实世界的图呈现出明显的社区结构，而消息传递在两个时间尺度上运行：节点表示在社区内部迅速坍缩，而在社区之间则缓慢坍缩。这造成了一个关键性的盲区——社区内部的表示可能变得无法区分，而社区之间的分离仍然存在，我们将这种失效模式称为“回音室效应”。为了量化这一效应，我们提出了回音室指数，该指数按社区成员身份对成对距离进行分层，能够揭示全局能量衰减但社区间分离仍然存在的情形。ECI 进一步表明，在理论分析所给出的条件下，特征保留机制可能无法消除回音室效应。
tldr: 该论文揭示了图神经网络中除过度平滑之外的另一种失效模式——回音室效应，即社区内部节点表示坍缩为不可区分而社区间分离却仍然存在，并提出回音室指数（ECI）来量化检测这一效应。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies a new GNN failure mode beyond oversmoothing—the Echo Chamber Effect, where intra-community representations collapse into indistinguishability while inter-community separation persists—and proposes the Echo Chamber Index (ECI) to quantify and detect it.
